issue.title: Conflicting Namespaces in TensorFlow Lite Libraries

comment.body:
This issue appears already resolved by the TensorFlowLite2LiteRT migration work.

The original problem described a namespace conflict between old TensorFlow Lite artifacts (`tensorflow-lite-gpu:2.9.0` and `tensorflow-lite-api:2.8.0`). That dependency set is no longer present in the current repo.

Historical verification:
- commit `5c684857` (`milestone/TensorFlowLite2LiteRT`) moved the project onto the MediaPipe/LiteRT-backed path and removed the old conflicting dependency setup

Current repo state also reflects that:
- MediaPipe `tasks-vision` is the active ML dependency
- the old conflicting TensorFlow Lite dependency pair is no longer in the build config

Closing as already resolved by the TensorFlowLite2LiteRT migration.
